title: Event Logger — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Event Logger solution should meet the objective: Emit an event for each state-changing operation and assert event fields in local tests. Explain what events do not make readable to another contract. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
